decisions.reason: As a specialist naval lighting system that fits our robust marine offering, it is too early after a 2023 launch to judge demand and the option value of remaining in the market exceeds the likely low carrying cost.

The spring-balanced desk lamp supports our ergonomic office-lighting proposition, and its dedicated product page suggests enough initial commitment to keep the option open while market acceptance becomes clearer.

This general interior luminaire is close to our core business and the explicit 'Newly arrived' presentation indicates an active rollout, so we should keep backing it while early sales information accumulates.
A pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics fits our standards-compliant, application-specific building portfolio, and after only one year there is not enough evidence to justify abandoning it.
The marine HMI searchlight serves a demanding niche with long customer decision cycles, so uncertainty remains high and keeping it preserves valuable optionality in specialist marine lighting.
The marine searchlight complements our specialist lighting range and broad solution coverage, and with so little time since launch the prudent real-options choice is to keep it on the market.
